EN:
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Yeah, I'm a rain freak too!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} When it
rains, I get energized, {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Yo es que simplemente soy adicta
a la lluvia, porque sí.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} ¡La lluvia me
pone las pilas, {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Anche a me la pioggia fa un effetto
strano!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Mi fa sentire piena di
energie, {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Jap, ich bin der totale Regenfreak!
{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}Ich fühle mich immer so lebendig,
wenn's schüttet, {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Aynen, ben de yağmur delisiyim!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Yağınca
enerjim tavan yapıyor, {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Yeah, I'm not letting the rain beat
me either.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} You inspired me!
{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Hai ragione. Non devo farmi
deprimere dalla pioggia.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0000:0004:}}Devo essere imperturbabile,
come te, {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Genau!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Das is' die richtige
Einstellung.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Wir lassen uns von
dem Sauwetter nicht unterkriegen!

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}I love it when it's pouring rain!{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} It
gets me all charged up and super
happy! {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}J'adore m'faire saucer par des
trombes de pluie !{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} Ça m'file une
banane pas possible,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}} !
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Adoro quando piove forte!{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} Mi fa
sentire carica come non mai e
strafelice, {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Bardaktan boşanırcasına yağmasına
bayılıyorum!{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} Beni resmen şarja takıyor,
keyfim yerine geliyor! {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}It's dark, it's wet, and it's cold.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} It's
hard to have tons of fun when it's
raining out, {{TAG:0005:0007:}}.
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Es de noche, llueve y hace frío.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Se
me está arruinando la fiesta, ¡esto
no me mola nada, {{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Certes, c'est pas les conditions
idéales pour s'amuser. {{TAG:0007:0000:0F000000}}Mais on en a
vu d'autres, {{TAG:0005:0007:}} !
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Piove, fa freddo ed è buio.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Non
vedo proprio come sia possibile
divertirsi, {{TAG:0005:0007:}}.
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Karanlık, ıslak ve soğuk.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Böyle havada
deli gibi eğlenmek kolay
değil, {{TAG:0005:0007:}}.

ES:
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}¡Pues como debe ser!{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} Yo me apunto
a días de lluvia, noches de lluvia... ¡y
lo que sea de lluvia, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}C'est tout à fait un temps à mettre
une grenouille dehors !{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} Et en plus, y
fait nuit,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}} ! Le top !
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Sono con te!{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} Per me quando piove,
che sia giorno o che sia notte,
è il massimo, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Ben de seninleyim!{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} Yağmurlu gündüzlere de
gecelere de bayılırım, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}I thought only the frogs in the pond
could get along in the rain, you 
know?{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} {{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Pensavo che solo le rane nello
stagno fossero abituate alla
pioggia... {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0028:}}Hätte nicht gedacht, dass du
Regennächte so toll findest.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Du bist
doch gar kein Frosch, {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Yağmurda sadece göletteki kurbağalar
rahat eder sanıyordum, biliyor
musun?{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} {{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
